items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: >> [(prose)] And it had a movie, Fred McMurray and some kind of Pines.

ctx.x: Yeah, 'cause I went there in '32, so I'd say end of '33, 'cause I -- yeah, it was '33 'cause there was a movie--I remember one time I went over there and got there too early, so I went to the movie next door
And it had a movie, Fred McMurray and some kind of Pines.
